summary: A 1935 pole tower with an L-6 cab near Eastport, abandoned in the 1950s. The index lists the tower as gone; a frame cabin may remain.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com says a frame cabin was still there, while the Forest Fire Lookout Association index lists the tower as gone. Both can be true: the tower is gone and a cabin may remain. The 2025 Ruby Cabin post may describe that cabin, but it does not name Ruby Mountain.

notes_for_editor: The Ruby Cabin post (bchistoricplaces.org, April 11, 2025) probably describes the frame cabin firelookout.com mentions, but the post never names Ruby Mountain. Confirm before saying so on a public page. Hollice Aldridge's dates: 1933 on firelookout.com, 1933-1934 on Idaho Fire Lookouts. The 1950s abandonment has no exact year; the event uses 1950 with a note. firelookout.com credits its photos to Kyle Cossairt and Luke Channer; no licence is known, so none are added. No source gives a current access status.
